messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Beta I found a good flight for your Umrah trip — PIA direct, 145,000 return.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: That's reasonable Ammi. Book it through the official website only, okay?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Yes yes, your uncle will help me pay by card at his office.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Great. Send me the booking reference once done, I'll verify it online myself.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Sure beta. May Allah bless you.
